comment: Display policy shared by every renderer (RealityKit reads it here, three.js from the package's profiles/display.json). Decisions: Prompt 5 (render below 3×: start at 2.5×, scale down to 2.0× as heat rises; pause when hidden). Calm mode (30 fps for an idle view) was dropped on 2026-10-06 (owner decision): RealityView has no frame-rate control.

renderScale.comment: Pixels per point, never above the screen's native scale. Steps down at once when the thermal state rises; steps back up only after the device has stayed at a cooler state for raiseAfterSeconds.

hidden.comment: Stop rendering while the view is off screen or the app is not active; resume on return.
